description.p: Neelima embeds the AI provider's own web chat (your account, your login — inside an isolated webview) or local models (Ollama, LM Studio) and lets them read and modify files in your workspace through a permission-gated tool protocol with git checkpoints.
No cloud model APIs. No API keys. No telemetry. No accounts.
First release: web-chat adapters, manual relay, Ollama + LM Studio, tool protocol with approvals and diffs, checkpoints, integrated terminal.
